notes: ACCESS: HSN Home dept sits behind Akamai Bot Manager. Tier(a) direct HTTP (urllib/curl, plain and curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124) got 403 Access Denied (plain) or a 200 Akamai JS-challenge shell with no real content (curl_cffi) on every /shop/ page; only worked for the XML sitemap host path. Tier(b) Playwright with the bundled Chromium (headless, and headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled) also got 403 outright. Escalated to tier(c): mcp__claude-in-chrome list_connected_browsers returned [] (no browser connected), so tier(c) was unavailable. Fell back to tier(b) with Playwright launched against the machine's real installed Google Chrome via channel='chrome' (still headed, still --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled) - this passed the Akamai check and returned full rendered pages (200, real content) consistently. robots.txt (www.hsn.com/robots.txt) has no Claude-bot/anthropic-ai disallow and no blanket Disallow: / , so tier(c) was permitted in principle, just not reachable in this environment; used tier(b) real-Chrome-channel throughout instead. Two individual leaf fetches failed transiently (outdoor-rugs/ho0255 403, coat-racks-and-umbrella-stands/ho0132 timeout) but their exact counts were still obtained from a sibling page's own rendered department-box aria-label, so no data was lost. TREE: built from union of (1) https://www.hsn.com/sitemap sitemap-index -> the 'home' department's 83 paginated sub-sitemaps (https://www.hsn.com/sitemap/ho?name=home&p=1..83, fetched via plain urllib, 3366 unique URLs total, 266 matching the category-listing pattern /shop/<slug>/ho<digits>), and (2) the rendered 'Departments' facet box on each hub/leaf page (Bedding, Bath, Storage & Organization, Home Decor, Rugs, Window Treatments, Cleaning & Laundry, and each mid-level hub such as Duvets & Shams / Mattress Pads & Protectors / Sheets & Pillowcases), which exposes each node's direct children and confirms leaf-vs-hub status (a leaf page's own Departments box repeats the same sibling set with no new children). Every recorded node's h1/title was checked against the URL requested. QTY: taken verbatim from each node's own aria-label '<Name> with N products' in the rendered department-box facet (the site's own computed count), or from the node's own page header '<N> items' when visited directly; never estimated or aggregated. EXCLUDED (checked, not recorded): Mattresses (bedding hub, 81, furniture/sleep product not textile); Bathroom Accessories (bath hub, 8, generic decor accessories - soap dishes/tumblers, no storage-specific naming or evidence); Bathroom Hardware, Bathroom Furniture, Bathroom Mirrors (bath hub, hardware/furniture/mirrors, out of scope); Clocks, Home Accents (749), Wall Decor (431) under Home Decor hub (decorative accessories / wall decor task scope, not textile except Tapestries which was pulled out separately); Food Bags, Wraps & Sealers (storage hub, 15, consumable kitchen supplies not storage containers); Garage Accessories (634, 21, mixed automotive/tools/hardware category with no clear storage-primary evidence, excluded per ambiguity rule rather than forced in); Window Treatments hub URL (duplicate alias of Curtains & Drapes, identical 13-item count, same content - one record kept per duplicate rule); Room Dividers, Bookcases & Shelves, Chairs, Sofas, Ottomans & Benches, Entertainment Centers, Tables (all Furniture task scope, seen as siblings of Slipcovers); Automotive, Hardware, Lighting & Electrical, Paint & Adhesives, Pest Control, Security, Tools & Tools Sets (garage-accessories siblings, all out of scope); Christmas Trees, Indoor/Outdoor Decor, Lights, Ornaments & Tree Toppers, Wreaths Garlands & More (christmas-storage siblings, decorative/lighting scope); Desk Chairs, Desks (office-storage siblings, furniture); Hand Tools, Power Tools (tool-storage siblings, tools themselves); Entryway Tables (entryway-cabinets-and-storage sibling, furniture); Mirrors, Wall Accents, Wall Art (tapestries siblings, wall decor task scope); Accents, Arbors, Artificial Plants, Fencing, Fountains & Bird Baths, Garden Statues & Sculptures, Outdoor Lighting, Mailposts (outdoor-cushions-and-pillows siblings, decorative/garden scope); Patio Chairs/Chaises/Garden Stools/Hammocks/Outdoor Benches/Patio Furniture Sets/Patio Umbrellas & Shade/Outdoor Tables (patio-storage siblings, furniture).
